verdict.rationale: Zero is a self-hostable AI email app, so outbound webhooks for events such as new mail are a fair axis. The evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks of any kind. The only programmatic surface is an MCP capability list authenticated by a browser session cookie, and an independent note says there is no public HTTP API. The generic 'Developer-Friendly' integrations claim does not count as webhook support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
